bono.overviewDescription: Bonos are custody tokens, not sales. This ledger shows who holds them, what moved today, and whether the day's report is ready for the Owner.
bono.noStaffHolder: No staff member currently holds a Bono.
bono.movementsBlurb: Issues, transfers and incidents are append-only. Lost Bonos are never treated as sales or breakage.
bono.noMovements: No movements recorded for this date.
bono.reportsBlurb: The Cashier prepares and submits one report per operational day. The Owner approves or rejects it; an approved report is never edited in place.
bono.prepareReportBlurb: Opening stock, receipts, sales and breakage are read from the existing ledgers when the report opens. Only the physical counts and explanations are entered here.
bono.op.actionFailed: That action could not be recorded.
bono.op.enterWholeNumber: Enter a whole number of Bonos.
bono.op.chooseDifferentStaff: Choose a different staff member to receive the Bonos.
bono.op.recorded: Recorded. The day ledger is up to date.
bono.op.lockedNote: This day's report has been submitted, so Bono custody is locked. A report rejected by the Owner reopens the day for correction.
bono.op.blurb: Record a hand-out, a hand-over between staff, or a loss. Each action is append-only and attributed to the signed-in manager.
bono.op.whatHappened: What happened to the Bonos or stock
bono.op.noTypesYet: No Bono types exist yet. An owner must configure at least one type before custody can be recorded.
bono.op.transferHint: A transfer never creates a new Bono: it moves one already in staff custody. Example:
bono.fu.actionFailed: That follow-up could not be recorded.

bono.fu.reasonForDeduction: A reason is required for a payroll deduction.
bono.fu.amountGreaterThanZero: Enter a deduction amount greater than zero.
bono.fu.deductionRecorded: Deduction recorded on the payroll line. The incident is marked deducted.
bono.fu.notOnPayroll: {name} is not on payroll. Add them to payroll before recording a deduction.
bono.fu.noGeneratedRun: No generated payroll run is open. Generate and leave a run unapproved before deducting.
bono.fu.amountHint: The amount defaults to the Bono price times the lost quantity; change it if the Owner agreed a different recovery.
bono.fu.describeResolution: Describe how the loss was resolved or why no deduction is being made.
bono.fu.markedReviewed: Lost Bono marked reviewed with no payroll deduction.
bono.fu.closeBlurb: The Bono stays recorded as lost. It does not become a sale, breakage or payroll deduction unless you explicitly record one.
bono.fu.followUpBlurb: Recording a lost Bono never creates a sale, breakage or deduction by itself. The Owner and Manager decide each outcome explicitly.
bono.fu.followUpClosed: Follow-up is closed while this day's report is submitted.
bono.rd.actionFailed: That action could not be completed.
bono.rd.usedInvalid: Used and returned Bonos must be whole, non-negative numbers.
bono.rd.physicalNotNumber: Physical closing quantities must be numbers.
bono.rd.rejectedReturned: Report rejected and returned to the Cashier.
bono.rd.notFound: That report could not be found.
bono.rd.correctsDescription: This revision corrects report #{n}. The earlier revision stays unchanged in history.
bono.rd.description: Product stock lines remain independent; a shared Bono total never decides an individual product's sales.
bono.rd.moneyNote: These are the existing sales and payment totals for the day. They are not inferred from Bono usage.
bono.rd.accountabilityBlurb: Issued = initial plus additional. Unexplained = issued - used - returned - lost. A transfer moves custody but does not create a new Bono.
bono.rd.noBonoActivity: No Bono activity was recorded for this date.
bono.rd.productReconciliationBlurb: Each product is counted on its own. Opening, receipts, sales and breakage come from the existing stock ledger.
bono.rd.noProductPaired: No product was paired to a Bono type during this day.
bono.rd.activityRefreshed: Activity refreshed from the Bono and stock ledgers.
bono.rd.submitLocksNote: Submitting locks Bono custody for this date. Every product line needs a physical count.
bono.rd.approveBlurb: Approval freezes this revision. If it turns out to be wrong, start an explicit correction instead of editing it.
bono.rd.rejectBlurb: A rejection reopens the day for the Cashier. The reason is shown to them.
bono.rd.startCorrectionBlurb: The approved report stays immutable. A new draft revision is opened, linked back to this one, and must go through submission and approval again.
bono.rd.reviseApprovedWhy: Why this approved report must be revised
bono.rd.waitingForOwner: This report is waiting for the Owner. The day stays locked until it is approved or rejected.
bono.rd.approvedImmutable: This report is approved and immutable. Ask the Owner to start a correction if something is wrong.
